data.name: BONK Voyage
data.detailed_description:
Crew Up

Form a crew of up to four and work together to survive the void. Coordinate your roles, share the workload and keep each other in check. Every delivery depends on your team pulling together. And just try not to bonk each other into space while you’re at it.

Keep It Together

Your ship is your lifeline. Navigate through space, locate your target planets and make sure everything stays in one piece along the way. If things do go wrong, get to work and repair the damage before it gets worse. Keep moving and keep it together.

Grab, Boost, Deliver

Your ship can only get you so close to your destination. From there you leave it behind, grab onto the asteroids and boost yourself through zero gravity the rest of the way, package in hand. One wrong move and you might find yourself drifting a little further than planned.

data.short_description: You and your friends are fearless space couriers delivering cargo to bizarre and exotic planets. Pilot the trusty old Croakpit, parkour across asteroids in zero gravity, and avoid getting bonked into the cold, dark void of space. Ready to tackle the universe's most dangerous delivery job?
